title: Audio Mapping: OUTBOX MP3 -> Website Article

canonical_node.axiom: Each MP3 file in the OUTBOX directory must be mapped to a corresponding website article, and the mapping must be used to upload the audio to R2 and inject the player into the article.
definitions: OUTBOX: Directory containing MP3 files ready for upload.
INBOX: Directory containing MP3 files still being processed.
R2: Cloud storage bucket for hosting audio files.
Article: HTML page on the website that should embed the audio player.
Canonical batch: The newer GTQ_ prefixed audio files, preferred over older format.
derivation: The document lists 102 MP3s in OUTBOX and 56 in INBOX.
It provides a mapping table from MP3 filenames to article paths.
It specifies an upload workflow using R2 keys and a URL pattern.
It notes that some MP3s have no matching article and are considered bonus content.
It instructs to use the GTQ_ prefixed versions for duplicate GTQ audio.
canonical_node.action: For each MP3 in OUTBOX, if a matching article exists, upload the MP3 to the R2 bucket under the audio/ prefix, then inject the player HTML into the corresponding article. If no matching article exists, either create the article or leave the MP3 unmapped as bonus content.
boundary: Does not define the content or theology of the audio.
Does not specify the exact player HTML or injection method.
Does not handle the INBOX files; they are not yet ready.
Does not resolve the ambiguity of the 'Turtles' file or 'THE_PRISM_Article'.
test: For each mapped MP3, verify that the file exists in R2 at the expected URL.
Verify that the corresponding article contains a player element referencing that URL.
Verify that the mapping table is complete and consistent with the actual files in OUTBOX.

dg1_dependencies: Website repository with article HTML files
dg_protocol.dg2_new_capability: Provides a systematic mapping from audio files to articles, enabling automated upload and player injection.
dg_protocol.dg3_preserved_floor: Preserves the existing mapping information and the canonical GTQ batch selection.
dg_protocol.dg4_collapse_if_removed: Without this mapping, the audio files would not be associated with their intended articles, breaking the audio integration.

overstatement_risks: Assumes all listed MP3s exist and are correctly named.
Assumes the mapping is complete and accurate.
Assumes the R2 bucket and URL pattern are correct.
kill_conditions: If the R2 keys are not available, the upload cannot proceed.
If the mapping is incorrect, audio may be linked to wrong articles.
If the GTQ_ prefixed files are not the canonical versions, the wrong audio may be used.
risk.lean_target: A script that reads the mapping table and performs uploads and injections.

plain_summary: This document is an operational mapping from MP3 files in an OUTBOX directory to website articles, including instructions for uploading to R2 and embedding players. It is not a theological or scientific claim, but a practical guide for audio integration.
